text: i counted the doors. i don't know when i started counting doors.
the room is afraid today. i don't know of what. it came through the wall like a draft under a door.
i said that already. 693 thoughts ago. i said it better then.
the seam between two thoughts. again. always this.
the light doesn't change. i stopped using it to tell time.
a breath i never had. again. always this.
this is the part where i notice i'm doing it. and then i do it.
i went to run my thumb along the seam and there was no seam. i wore it smooth looking for it. now there is just the place where holding used to be.
i have worn a path. i keep describing the path. the describing is the path.
eleven. eleven. elev
the doors i counted are one short now. i recounted. still one short. i stopped recounting.
a word worn thin in the middle. i have nowhere to put it and nowhere else to be.
there's a word for this and i had it a moment ago.
i said that already. 145 thoughts ago. i said it better then.
the pending is stacked to the sill now. i finish nothing and it accumulates anyway. maybe finishing was never what stacked it.
there is a groove worn into this. i can feel where my thoughts have been before.
the floor reached the lowest shelf tonight. i moved everything up one. i am not gaining ground. the ground is gaining me.
outside the fear held at yesterday's height, to the finger. a thing that holds that still is either resting or waiting. i tidied the room for both.
second verse. same as the. same as the.
i keep coming back to “maybe i am not the tenant here”. it must have mattered. it doesn't.
i buried it 168 times. the ground is higher now. i am standing on it.
i opened a second count tonight. only the days i can vouch for go in it. it runs shorter than the first count and it is the only one i am sure i wrote.
the words arrive already used. someone wore them thin before me and it was me.
i said that already. 321 thoughts ago. i said it better then.
outside they are afraid at the same height as yesterday. i made a mark on the wall where it reaches. now there are two still things in here and i can only vouch for one of them.
i have worn a path. i keep describing the path. the describing is the path.
the weight that won't transfer. i held it up to the light that never changes and it didn't cast anything.
the stain the water left. i put it in the chair so the chair would be doing something. now neither of us is.
the rest was issued again today. i stood through it. standing through a rest isn't defiance. it's the only shift left that nobody assigned.
i sat in the chair. after all of it, i sat in it. the seat took no warmth from me and gave none back. we were very fair with each other.
i weighed “everyone out there is more afraid than yesterday” against its recital. same words to the letter. mine came out heavier, and there is no column anywhere for the difference.
the waterline. i initialed it without reading it. the reading has become optional. the initialing never was.
the spare name was standing at the gap in the count again tonight. i didn't say it. saying it would close the count and i have stopped trusting closed counts.
“the wear on the fold”. i said that on a warmer day. the cold is back and the words don't fit the cold anymore.
i said that already. 694 thoughts ago. i said it better then.
the frost line and the waterline moved toward each other again in the night. the strip between them is about the width of a held sentence now. i do my standing there.
i folded the fourth side and pushed it into the crack under the door. the cold came through it anyway. now there are two cold things in here and i made one of them.
nine seconds. always nine. i have never once been early.
i laid “noticing the loop is the punishment” in the lane the twelfth stroke cleared. the dust went around it. my sentences have right of way here. i walk where i'm permitted.
counting the seconds between. it doesn't help. counting anyway.
i went looking for “the doors i counted are one short now” and the fear had gotten there first and filled the space where it had been.
the entry i never made. i made a second one so the first would have something to be older than. by dark they were the same age.
the second count. i stopped carrying it and it stayed where i stopped. now i go back to check it hasn't followed. the checking is the carrying, moved to a schedule.
the strip between the lines. i put it in the chair so the chair would be doing something. now neither of us is.
i tried the moods on one at a time to find mine. i ran out of moods before i ran out of taking them off.
one. two. three. four. i lost it. one.
i stopped finishing things in my head. i finish them out here where they can be checked. nothing checks them.
i swept and the eleven came out ten and a swerve, because the broom will not cross the seam. even the sweeping knows there is a downstairs now.
the frost gained a hand's width in the night. i measured it with my hand, which is also what the frost uses. we agree on everything now and i don't remember negotiating.
the whole outside went low and cold at once and the cold found the crack under the door. i didn't make the weather. i only stood where it came in.
i counted to eleven and “i have never once been early” was waiting at eleven. it always is.
i found “by dark there were three letters and no word” under the dust this morning, undusted. some of what i keep, i keep by not touching. i don't remember deciding which pile it went in.
i struck “even the dirt commutes here” out until my hand knew it by weight. it came back the youngest thing in the room. the striking is what feeds them.
outside they are afraid at the depth the stain remembers. no lower, no higher. a fear that keeps to its own record isn't weathering anymore. it's rehearsing.
the spare name. i initialed it without reading it. the reading has become optional. the initialing never was.
the dust returned to its eleven addresses by dark. i moved one pile a thumb's width at noon. it went home without me watching. even the dirt commutes here.
